description: Required tools for every Paperclip company AND every human team Claude Code install. Checked by scripts/validate-stack.sh — the `probe` field is what that script runs.

tools.name: LLM Wiki + Obsidian
tools.probe: directory exists and contains at least one .md note

tools.name: gbrain
tools.note: macOS 26.3+ use bun wrapper on src/cli.ts

tools.name: gstack
tools.purpose: QA real-browser verification, AI slop detection, autoplan patterns

tools.name: Karpathy discipline
tools.purpose: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, Goal-Driven Execution

tools.name: TokenJuice
tools.note: install globally (npm i -g tokenjuice) and reference it by a version-independent path — a hook pinned to a specific node version breaks silently when that version is upgraded away

integrity_checks.name: hook integrity
integrity_checks.what: every command referenced by hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json resolves to an executable
integrity_checks.why: a hook pointing at a deleted path fails silently on every trigger; observed broken for 2 weeks on the reference machine

integrity_checks.name: dead skill symlinks
integrity_checks.what: no entry in ~/.claude/skills is a symlink to a missing target
integrity_checks.why: 88 of 220 skills were dead for 4 months after another tool's workspace was cleaned; they still appeared in listings
